summary_en: Annual dividend per share raised by 0.50 yen to 9.50 yen for fiscal year ending March 2027, with year-end dividend increased by 0.50 yen to 6.50 yen. Interim dividend of 3.00 yen confirmed. Revision driven by upwardly revised operating profit, ordinary profit, and net income attributable to parent company shareholders.
title_en: Notice Regarding Revision of Dividend Forecast for Fiscal Year Ending March 2027 (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief:
On November 9, 2026, Migalo Holdings Inc. announced a revision to its dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027. The annual dividend per share was increased by 0.50 yen from the previous forecast of 9.00 yen to 9.50 yen. The year-end dividend per share was raised by 0.50 yen to 6.50 yen, while the interim dividend per share remains at 3.00 yen as previously announced on May 11, 2026.

The company based this upward revision on higher-than-expected financial performance, with operating profit, ordinary profit, and net income attributable to parent company shareholders all tracking ahead of the previous forecast. The company stated it arrived at this decision after comprehensively reviewing business conditions, shareholder return policy, retained earnings, equity ratio, funding environment, and cash position.

The revised dividend is subject to approval at the ordinary general meeting of shareholders scheduled for June 2027.
